impl LaneDrainForTheStrip {
    fn drain_controls_for_lane(&mut self, control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
        while let Some(PendingRecordForTheLane {
            very_long_field_name_one,
            very_long_field_name_two,
        }) = self.next_pending_record_for_the_lane()
        {
            let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
                break;
            };
            self.apply(record);
        }
    }
}
